title: Silver Zoom Card: Setting Spending Limits for Driver Cards
summary: This document explains how to set and manage daily spending limits for Silver Zoom Card driver cards: a daily cap per card up to $1,250, consistently across up to 60 issued under the account. It covers how to enable daily controls, set limits (all purchases vs specific categories like fuel), save/confirm settings, notify drivers, adjust thresholds, and refine based on declines.
faqs: How do I set a daily spending limit for a specific driver’s Silver Zoom Card?
What is the maximum daily cap I can set for driver cards ($1,250 or less)?
Can I apply the same limit across multiple driver cards under my account (up to 60)?
Should the daily limit apply to all purchases or only certain categories like fuel?
How do I temporarily raise or lower the limit for unusual routes, then restore it?
How can I review declines tied to limit controls and adjust thresholds?
